text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- ADC Airlines says it has made ready the entitlements of the victims of a November air crash which killed 143. The Sunday Times gathered that the National Insurance Company of Nigeria took earnings of the victims into account when calculating entitlements.
- At least 3,000 jobs may be lost in the oil marketing sector as low profit margins make staff rationalisation inevitable.
- Nigerian Railway Corporation has allocated more trains for Lagos routes to lessen transportation difficulties in the area.
- Airport authorities say they may auction grounded aircraft whose owners are not paying fees to park them at airports.
- Nigeria may lose an average of 1.44 billion naira yearly due to the export of poor quality cocoa, officials of the trade ministry say.
- Lagos state government relinquishes its majority stake in luxury Eko hotel. The new majority shareholders, United States based OHA Limited, have set aside 800 million naira for refurbishment.
